name: Cryptstalker Legguards
label: Quest
description: Cryptstalker Legguards: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have discovered a use for the carapace of the crypt fiend. I am able to fashion an extremely light and very deadly set of armor by combining the fragments with some of the desecrated magical armors lost in Naxxramas.
Bring me the items I require and I shall fashion for you a suit of armor the likes of which has never before been seen in our world!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the items I asked for, adventurer?

clips.title: Completion
paras: As you don more of this armor, you will notice that your persona is changing. You will gain a preternatural ability for killing. Perhaps, even, a lust for blood.
Let it be said that I will not be held responsible for what chaos you may invoke...
